title: List all products with category, price, and rating
description: Returns all products in the catalog with their type, category, price, and rating.

title: Products in a category (e.g. PC Components)
description: Returns products in a given top-level category with subcategory, price, and rating.

title: GPUs sorted by price with key specs
description: Returns all GPUs with VRAM, TDP, performance tier, and price.

title: Motherboards compatible with a CPU (via shared socket)
description: Finds motherboards that share a socket type with a named CPU, demonstrating graph traversal through specification nodes.

title: RAM kits compatible with a motherboard (via shared RAM type)
description: Finds RAM that matches a motherboard's memory generation.

title: Cases with enough GPU clearance for a specific GPU
description: Finds cases where the maximum GPU length exceeds the GPU's physical length.

title: PSUs with sufficient wattage for a CPU + GPU combination
description: Finds PSUs that can handle the combined TDP of a CPU and GPU with headroom.

title: CPU-GPU pairings with performance score gap
description: Shows the performance score difference between all CPU-GPU pairings to identify potential bottlenecks.

title: Products currently on sale
description: Returns products that have an original price higher than the current price, with the discount amount.

title: Products suitable as gifts under a budget
description: Returns products with high gift suitability under a price threshold.

title: Product alternatives and relationships
description: Returns all alternative-to and works-well-with relationships between products.

title: All valid CPU-Motherboard-RAM combinations
description: Finds all combinations where CPU socket matches motherboard socket and RAM type matches motherboard RAM type.

title: Camping gear organised by subcategory
description: Returns all outdoor gear grouped by subcategory with price totals.

title: All compatibility constraints with rules and messages
description: Returns all hard and soft constraints with their rules, slot types, and user-facing messages.
